title: North Florida Fair announces entertainment lineup for November event in Tallahassee
text:
North Florida Fair announces entertainment lineup for November event in Tallahassee
The North Florida Fair will return to Tallahassee from November 5 to 15 with a full lineup of family entertainment. Organizers say all shows are included with admission, and the event will feature live music, livestock shows, and more. The fair is celebrating its 84th year as a community tradition.
The North Florida Fair will return to Tallahassee from November 5 to 15, bringing a range of family entertainment as part of its 84th annual event.
Organizers said the fair will feature high-flying BMX stunts, racing pigs, puppet shows, living statues, and the Fairnatics, among other attractions. All featured entertainment is included with the price of gate admission, and no separate show tickets are required. "This year’s entertainment lineup offers something for guests of all ages, with returning favorites and new experiences designed to keep families entertained throughout their visit," according to the North Florida Fair Association.
The fair will also include live music, livestock shows, and traditional fair favorites. Organizers said the event is designed to provide a venue for community events and to support local culture and businesses. "The North Florida Fair is a premier venue for community events, offering a variety of agricultural, educational, and entertainment experiences throughout the year. We are committed to creating memorable experiences and supporting local culture and businesses," according to the North Florida Fair Association.
The North Florida Fair Association operates at 441 Paul Russell Road in Tallahassee and hosts events throughout the year. More information about upcoming events and the full entertainment lineup can be found on the fair’s website.
The fair is a longstanding tradition in the region, marking its 84th year in 2026.
